create_program: create a launchpad Program instance with a given name to represent a distributed program topology
add_node_to_program: add a node to a launchpad Program with an optional label for grouping homogeneous nodes
build_program_with_group: build a launchpad program using group context manager to organize homogeneous nodes under a label
get_all_nodes_from_program: get all nodes from a launchpad Program by retrieving nodes across all groups
create_program_with_make_program: create a launchpad program from a list of nodes using the make_program shortcut function
